autofocus.zh-CN: 挂载时是否自动聚焦到第一个输入框。只在用户明确进入验证码输入步骤时开启，页面加载时自动聚焦会让读屏跳过之前的内容。
autofocus.en-US: Whether to focus the first input on mount. Turn it on only when the user has just entered the code step: focus moving at page load makes screen readers skip the content before it.

format.zh-CN: 单个字符的格式限制：number 只允许数字，mixed 允许数字和字母，正则或函数按字符判定。
format.en-US: Format limit for a single character: number allows digits only, mixed allows digits and letters, and a regular expression or function judges each character.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开整个验证码时的回调。
onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves the whole code.

onChange.zh-CN: 内容变化时的回调，参数为当前内容。
onChange.en-US: Called when the content changes, with the current content.

onComplete.zh-CN: 所有位数输入完毕时的回调，参数为当前内容。
onComplete.en-US: Called once all digits are entered, with the current content.

onFocus.zh-CN: 焦点进入整个验证码时的回调，在输入框之间移动不触发。
onFocus.en-US: Called when focus enters the code from outside; moving between the inputs does not call it.

size.en-US: Input size: large, default or small.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，传给每个输入框；error 时显示错误样式。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status, passed to every input; error shows the error style.

value.zh-CN: 输入框内容，可用 `bind:value` 双向绑定。`bind:value={get, set}` 时完全受控；只传 `value` 时作为初值。
value.en-US: Input content; bind it with `bind:value`. `bind:value={get, set}` makes it fully controlled; a plain `value` is the initial value.

blur.zh-CN: 让第 index 个输入框失焦，序号从 0 开始，超出范围时忽略。
blur.en-US: Blurs the input at index, counted from 0 and ignored when out of range.

focus.zh-CN: 聚焦第 index 个输入框，序号从 0 开始，超出范围时忽略；光标放在该格字符之后。
focus.en-US: Focuses the input at index, counted from 0 and ignored when out of range, with the caret after its character.
